source = '''def _components(grid, cells):
    remaining = set(cells)
    result = []
    while remaining:
        start = remaining.pop()
        comp = {start}
        stack = [start]
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                if p in remaining:
                    remaining.remove(p)
                    comp.add(p)
                    stack.append(p)
        result.append(comp)
    return result


def _shape(cells):
    mr = min(r for r, c in cells)
    mc = min(c for r, c in cells)
    return frozenset((r-mr, c-mc) for r, c in cells)


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    top_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    bottom_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(divider + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    bot_row = min(r for r, c in bottom)

        out[5 + r - bot_row][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
